## What I found

This SaaS pivoted from an email-cleanup product ("InboxZap") to an AI meeting assistant ("Lumina") on the same domain, and the migration left real SEO damage visible in both the GSC export and the live site:

- **`/faq` 404'd.** Nav links to it site-wide, but it had been redirected to a `/#faq` anchor that doesn't exist on the homepage.
- **The blog was broken.** The index page fetched posts from `/api/posts`, which returns 404 — visitors and crawlers saw an infinite "Loading posts…" spinner, and the 12 existing posts (pulling ~9,500 impressions/month combined) had zero internal links pointing at them.
- **Sitemap only listed 4 URLs** — none of the 12 blog posts were in it, despite them being indexed and getting impressions.
- **Stale branding leaked through metadata.** The root layout still had InboxZap's title/description as the fallback, which any page without its own metadata override would inherit.
- **Content/intent mismatch.** The 12 ranking blog posts are 100% about Gmail/Outlook inbox cleanup — completely irrelevant to a meeting assistant, which is why they get impressions but ~0% CTR. None had meta descriptions either.
- Minor: duplicate `<h1>` on Features, missing FAQ schema, no internal links from the homepage to Features/Blog.

## What I did

- Rebuilt the content model (`lib/posts.ts`) and added real server-rendered routes: `/features`, `/pricing`, `/faq`, `/blog`, `/blog/[slug]`.
- Fixed the blog index to render server-side (no more dependency on a dead API) and linked every post.
- Added each page's own metadata (title/description/canonical/OG), fixed the layout's stale default metadata, and added Organization/SoftwareApplication/Article/FAQPage JSON-LD.
- Added meta descriptions to all 12 legacy posts, and appended a short contextual "bridge" + internal link to the ones where it made sense, connecting old inbox-overload search traffic to Lumina's actual value prop instead of letting it dead-end.
- Added 3 new posts targeting real product-relevant keyword gaps (meeting notes, AI meeting notes comparison, meeting-driven email overload) — topics with zero existing content despite being core to what Lumina does.
- Fixed the sitemap to include every page and post; removed the broken `/faq` redirect; fixed the duplicate-`<h1>` on Features.
- Verified everything with `next build` + `next start` (all routes 200, correct titles, no title-template duplication bugs).

One thing I couldn't fix: `og:image` points at `/img/og-lumina.png`, which doesn't exist in `public/` — that needs an actual design asset, not something I can fabricate.
